input_manifest.provenance: Regional observations scaled to virtual load; all assets are modelled

export_scope: Snapshot of persisted records; an active run can continue after export.

sources.name: Karnataka daily supplied energy

metrics.selection_reason: Lowest chronological validation MAE: xgb_absolute (8.20178 GWh); persistence wins ties. Selection frozen before final-test scoring.
